_help: The tracks to choose from in the lobby. 'half' is the first half of a lap, from the start/finish line to the middle of the back straight: straights (metres) and left turns (degrees, radius in metres, banking in degrees). It must turn 180° in all; the second half is its mirror image, and the straight back to the middle is added for you. 'width' is the racing surface in metres; 'time' is day, dusk or night; 'scenery' is countryside, desert, harbour or city.

tracks.name: Beacon Speedway
tracks.about: The classic, out in the hills: two long straights, two fast banked turns. 1.5 km.

tracks.name: Red Mesa Tri-Oval
tracks.about: Out in the desert at sunset. A kink in the front stretch, so it's never quite straight.

tracks.name: Harbour Short Track
tracks.about: Down by the docks, under the lights. Tight and steep: bumping is how you pass. 0.7 km.

tracks.name: Grand Oval
tracks.about: The big one, on the edge of the city: 2.7 km, flat out, three wide in the draft.
